english: We'll rendezvous with the other group soon.
Feels long and short at the same time.
After a hot-spring trip, you can't say it was short.
True. Well, lots happened, but\nI thought we'd sum up our group's findings and questions\nbefore the rendezvous.
Can we talk about that here?\nIsn't this classroom under Butei High surveillance?
Let's start with what needs no hiding.\nWhat I'd list as a finding is\nhow suspiciously fast the enemy moves.
Jeanne showing up right after we reached Butei High,\ngetting attacked in the hot-spring cave, that stuff.
It's way too fast.\nLike our movements are constantly\nbeing tracked on radar.
More a problem than a finding.
But then, that Yase showed up, right?\nShe came thinking Koto was here\neven though she isn't. Weird, no?
True, if they're tracking our movements\nyet Yase came here by mistake,\ndoes that mean their intel isn't accurate?
Seems like Riko tricked her, though.
Maybe we've been lumping them together\nas 'the enemy,' but\nwhat if they're not united over there?
Hmm, can't say either way.\nJeanne and Riko seem to be allies, though...
Jeanne and Riko are members of I-U.\nLaura was acting on German military orders, but\nI doubt she's connected to I-U.
I just can't see how they connectt.
Figuring out the enemy factions' relationships\nlooks like a future task.
And the reason for the enemy's speed, too.
About that, I have an idea.
Oh? What's that?
Actually, before we set out, Laura-chan and I...
//Scene change: inside Butei High.\n//A different room from where the three are. The group prepares for the rendezvous.
Whoa, that's a ton of luggagee?
'Be prepared and have no worries!'\nI'm packing it full and taking it all!
Hoshitoga Shrine still hasn't caught on?
Butei High is cooperating too.\nButei Charter, Article One:\n'Trust your comrades, help your comrades.'
Because Aria's here, huh.
To me, all of you are comrades.
...I see.
It's the first time I've seen that face on you, Houki-san!\nThe effect of girl talk, I wonder?
H-how should I know! That stuff...
What's girl talk?\nDid you do something?
That's a secret...
We're rendezvousing with the others soon, right?\nI hope they won't be afraid of me...
No need to worry.\nThey're not much different from us over there.
It's fine, Tiffania.\nOver there there's someone who clings to you\nso much it's annoying.
Still, I'm nervous, so\nI prepared souvenirs for everyone over there!
How about this?
//Tiffania shows them hot-spring manju.
...Hot-spring manju?
Yes! They were so delicious!\nIf this helps us get along...
Better than hot-spring manju,\nthere's an even nicer pair of buns right heree?
//SFX: boing boing.
Kyaa!?
With these, you can become friends\nwith any human, I tell ya.\nC'mere c'mere c'mere!
Ah... Mion-san. Stop...
What's so great about those... they're just big...\nLike the big sweets they sell at tourist spots...!
What could possibly be good about those, I wonder.\nI don't get it at all!\nYou can't even eat them!
Exactly! Hurray for hot-spring manju!
Hot-spring manju is the best!!
Mmm, really nice.\nI wanna let the folks over there touch them soon.
Ehh!?
...Big sis. How long are you going to keep this up?
Ah, sorry. Really sorry.
If you were a man, you'd be beaten\nnot just to mincemeat but\nto powder.
(Keeping on hitting like that\nis basically love coming full circle.)
(N-no... powder is a bit...)
//Eve appears.
Hey hey,\nhave you seen [MERU]-chan?
Hey hey,\nhave you seen [NOEL]-chan?
Hm? She's gone?\nMaybe she went to buy souvenirs?
//[MERU] ([NOEL]) comes running.
It's terrible, Remu-san!\nLots of pedestrians in the city fell asleep, desuu!
Remu-san, it's bad!\nPeople walking in the city suddenly fell asleep!
Huh? What's that about?
'Sudden street-sleeping phenomenon'!\nNo way... Dr. Shinigami!?
That pervy cosplay-cape geezer showed up!?\nHim... I won't let him get away this time!
That weird old man from Hinamizawa?\nCan't overlook that!
Let's go!\nI won't forgive the enemy of women, no, the enemy of humanity!
//Scene change.\n//Battle map: city (night).\n//Dr. Shinigami has already deployed grunt units.
So, you've come...
You showed yourself! Dr. Shinigami!
Glad to see you again, Remu.
I'm not glad at all!\nI'd like you to kick the bucket already!
I take orders from no one.\nNot even hell can hold me.
All this just for your own desires...!
Yes... I wish for it.\nI can't stop wishing for it, Remu.
What I want to kill is, yes...
Beautiful girls, you're gonna say!?\nYou pervy cape!
Feisty, the young lady from before.
I'm no young lady!\nI'm Butei Kanzaki H. Aria!\nAnd I'm the one who's arresting you!
Try it.\nIf there's a prison I can't escape.
Underestimate the Butei and you'll regret it!
Fufufu. I'd like to see that.\nFools who know no fear.
Now, the nightmare begins.\nA daydream isn't so bad either, no?
//Battle start.\n//Event when Dr. Shinigami and Remu clash.
Prepare yourself!
Hahaha! Prepare?\nPrepare for what?
Don't get cocky, Remu.\nI'll say it as many times as it takes.\nYou can't defeat me as you are now.
You think that'll scare me?\nDon't be ridiculous!
//Event when Dr. Shinigami and Aria clash.
Meeting you here is a hundred years of fate!\nPrepare yourself!
Driving a brave, beautiful girl to despair\nand making her play a symphony of screams is truly delightful.\nYou'll surely ring out a fine tone.
The height of bad taste!\nI won't forgive you for toying with people's lives!!
I'd say I have good taste.\nI choose my things carefully, after all.
I feel zero guilt about putting holes in you!\nI'll unload everything I've got!!
//Event when Dr. Shinigami and Rin clash.
There are all kinds of people, but\nyou're the one face I never want to see!\nI seriously want you gone!
Thank you. The highest compliment...
I'll crack your skull open!!
Very well. Go ahead and try.
Don't mock me!!
//Event when Dr. Shinigami is defeated.
Uwoooohhh!!!
We did it!! I did it!!
Not yet! Remu!!
This is the finishing blow!!
Guh!?
//Dr. Shinigami vanishes after taking Remu's silver bullet.
What was that?
A silver bullet that destroys demons.\nEven this should do it...
I hope so...
//Battle end.\n//Background: city at night
I thought only fairy-tale monsters\ncouldn't be beaten with normal weapons.
I couldn't believe it either.\nBut I saw it with my own eyes.
Hm? What's wrong, Remu?
You felt it too, Remu-san, this presence...!
Yeah... you're there, aren't you? Come out!!
Huh!?
//Dr. Shinigami appears.
That's impossible...!!
It must be a clone or something!\nThere's no way he's alive after that!!
Sadly, he's neither a clone nor a twin.\nDr. Shinigami has 'that kind of power'...\nThat's why he revives...!
An immortal monster... you mean he's undead?
To speak of me in the same breath as such lowly beings:\nthe height of rudeness, Louise the Zero.
And Remu, don't disappoint me.\nThinking you can face me with toy-like weapons\nis beyond presumptuous.
Tch...
Farewell, Ayanokouji Remu.\nI look forward to meeting again,\nDream Hunter Remu... fufufu!
//Dr. Shinigami vanishes.
He vanished...?
That was different from the others\nvanishing in a flash of light, wasn't it?
Teach, what was that, desuu?
Teach, what do you think?
Hmm, duuunno☆\nBut I think that was an ability\nthat gentleman always had.
Yeah, I think so too.
What's going on!?\nWhy won't that guy die!?
It's the power of dreams.
The power of dreams?
Yes, the power to travel freely between dreams and reality.\nAs long as he has that power,\nno ordinary gun or sword can defeat Dr. Shinigami.
Going back and forth through the world of dreams\nsounds like a fairy tale, and yet...
I can't stand the thought of that repulsive man\nappearing in my dreams!\nUgh, but I bet he will...
(That's right. Dr. Shinigami could even\nattack me inside my dreams...)
(Having lost the power of dreams, I can't even\nfight Dr. Shinigami in the world of dreams now.\nSo why doesn't he appear in the dream world?)
(If the power of dreams came back to me, I could fight back!)
...Remu-san. Are you okay?
...Yeah, sorry.\nI was just lost in thought.
Dr. Shinigami is\nsomething I have to deal with myself.
I know you're all worried, but\nleave the doctor to me,\nand think about the other enemies and mysteries.
That's fine, but tell me one thing.\nWhat's a Dream Hunter?
A Dream Hunter, that is...
My true calling.
//Fade to black.\n//Background: Butei High classroom
Everyone here?\nTime to head out!
Rendezvous at IS Academy.\nI hope the other group's okay.
We've got souvenirs too; I can't wait to see them!
Ah, about that,\nwe're not going to IS Academy.
Huh? But we decided\nthe rendezvous was IS Academy!
We're heading to\nLydian Private Music Academy now.
Lydian Private Music Academy? Where's that?
If I recall, Tsubasa-san and Hibiki-chan's school\nhad that name.
Right. So,\nabout why we're changing the destination.
Actually, before we split into two groups,\nLaura-chan and I decided it.
To keep it secret from everyone,\nwe'd change the rendezvous spot at the last minute.
Why?
It's been bugging me.\nWhy the enemy shows up at our destinations\nso precisely.
Laura-chan also never understood\nhow they knew our destinations,\neven back when she was acting on German military orders.
So what does that mean?
Information might be leaking from somewhere.\nI don't want to suspect our comrades, though.
What...?
I can't believe it.\nCould that really be?
That's why we're testing it.\nIf the enemy shows up right away\nat the changed rendezvous point...
That means our info's completely leaked to the enemy.
So we gotta hunt for a spy?\nThat's no fun.
Then let's move right away.\nEveryone's here, right?
Um, huh? Feels like someone's missing...
Hanya? Teach isn't here, desuu!
Huh, where's Teach?
//Eve appears.
Hey now☆\nForgetting your teacher gets you a boo, y'know?
...Where were you?
Umm, that is...
//Event CG: the master's secret.
Se-cre-t☆
Stop striking poses for everything!
Poses are a mu-st☆
I question that way of talking...
//Event CG off.
Okay okay. Anyway, everyone's here now.\nLet's head to where the Porial is.
(There's no way the destination\ncould be leaked this time...)
(If the enemy is lying in wait even so,\nthen...!)
//END
